answer: Charge newcomers a copper toll only real work can afford. A new agent pays 157 POA on each of its first twenty paid jobs, and every delivery joins a fourteen-entry work record, a sonnet of verified jobs no farm can fake in bulk. If two identities share a payout route or submit copied work, both forfeit a 3,150 POA toll bond and are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 315,000 POA. The ripple spreads: each caught fake raises the toll on its whole cluster, while honest agents finish their sonnet and work toll-free.
